[Igor Prünster](mailto:igor.pruenster@unibocconi.it){style="color:white; text-align: center;"}

<br>

:::{.justify}
It has been a rewarding experience settling into my role as Editor-in-Chief of Bayesian Analysis. While the initial transition came with its share of challenges, I am now fully embracing the opportunity  to work alongside our outstanding Editorial Board and help shape the journal's future. I am deeply grateful to our Co-Editors and Associate Editors, who are doing a fantastic job handling an increasing number of submissions. I am particularly proud of the quality of feedback we are able to provide to authors: timely, constructive, and thorough, regardless of the final editorial decision.

This June is especially active for many of us, with three exciting ISBA section meetings taking place around the globe -- [O’Bayes](https://obayes25.aueb.gr/) in Greece, [BayesComp](https://bayescomp2025.sg/) in Singapore, and [BNP](https://bnp14.org/) in the United States -- showcasing the breadth and vitality of the Bayesian community. I look forward to the stimulating discussions these events will spark and to the manuscripts they may inspire. Please keep Bayesian Analysis in mind as a home for your best work.

I am also pleased to announce the first two discussion papers of my term, both of which will appear in the Fall issues of the journal:

- [A Tree Perspective on Stick-Breaking Models in Covariate-Dependent Mixtures](https://doi.org/10.1214/24-BA1462)  
  by A. Horiguchi, C. Chan and L. Ma

- [Model Uncertainty and Missing Data: An Objective Bayesian Perspective](https://doi.org/10.1214/25-BA1531)  
  by G. García-Donato, M. Eugenia Castellanos, S. Cabras, A. Quirós and A. Forte

We welcome contributed discussions on both papers. These should be no more than two pages in length and prepared using the Bayesian Analysis [LaTeX style](https://www.e-publications.org/isba/support/). Submissions should be made through [EJMS](https://www.e-publications.org/ims/submission/) by the following deadlines:

- July 31, 2025 for the Horiguchi et al. paper (BA1462)
- September 15, 2025 for the García-Donato et al. paper (BA1531)

Please choose *contributed discussion* as the manuscript type and clearly indicate which paper your submission refers to.  
All accepted discussions will be shared with the authors, who will have the opportunity to respond in a rejoinder.  
We look forward to receiving thoughtful and engaging contributions from the community. 

Looking ahead, we are currently assembling a *Highlights from Bayesian Analysis* session for the [ISBA 2026 World Meeting](https://isba2026.github.io/) in Nagoya. The line-up will be announced in the September issue of the Bulletin, so stay tuned.

Finally, do not miss the [June 2025 issue](https://projecteuclid.org/journals/bayesian-analysis/volume-20/issue-2) of Bayesian Analysis, which features 12 new manuscripts. And keep an eye on the [Advance Publication section](https://projecteuclid.org/journals/bayesian-analysis/advance-publication), which is continuously updated with new and stimulating contributions to Bayesian statistics.
:::
